[[Aliden Perenolde|Aliden]] (cousin) }} '''Isiden Perenolde''' was the nephew of Lord [[Aiden Perenolde]], King of [[Alterac (kingdom)|Alterac]]. When Alterac was placed under martial law by order of King [[Terenas Menethil II|Terenas]], Isiden fled to [[Gilneas]], where he hoped to rally support. He was eventually backed by [[Genn Greymane]], the king of [[Gilneas (kingdom)|Gilneas]], as the matter of the succession began to heat up.''[[Day of the Dragon]]'', pg. 7 Following the ascension of [[Mortimer Harlow|Mortimer]] and [[Celia Harlow]] as Regent-Lords of Gilneas in the absence of King Greymane, Isiden was imprisoned and held captive in the [[Dryrock Pit]].{{questlong|Alliance|44|Legacy of Perenolde}} However, he has since escaped. [[High Officer Osmark|High Officer Osmark Dryrock]] speculates that his breakout was orchestrated by loyalists hailing from Alterac, and that he may have sought refuge in the secluded and remote island of [[Tol Barad]]. Isiden's escape from the Dryrock Pit was kept secret from even the Regent-Lords in order to avoid destabilizing the broader political landscape of Gilneas.[[Dossier: Isiden Perenolde]] ==References== {{Reflist}} {{DEFAULTSORT:Perenolde, Isiden}} [[Category:Human characters]] [[Category:Aristocrats]] [[Category:Alterac (kingdom)]] [[Category:Lore characters]]
